title: 上海高考翻译背诵-69-25一模

items.zh: 国产品牌正在不遗余力地争取更大的市场份额。
items.en: Domestic brands are sparing no effort to strive for a bigger market share.

items.zh: 越来越多的人在购物时考虑环保因素，包括产品的可持续性。
items.en: A growing number of people are taking environmental factor into consideration when shopping, including the sustainability of products.

items.zh: 针对出游高峰期间交通堵塞中司机可能半路上的嗜睡的问题，现已推出无人机唤醒服务。
items.en: In response to the problem of drivers nodding off in traffic jams during holiday traffic congestion, a drone wake-up service has been introduced.

items.zh: 火箭不断成功发射与更新换代，这些都是我国国力日益强盛，科技实力日新月异的象征。
items.en: Rockets are being successfully launched and upgraded continuously, which symbolizes the growing national strength and the rapid advancement of science and technology in our country.
